name: Xiaomin Yang
source:
Student of the Uteme-Lovond Academy, Twin of Xiao Yang, but unlike him, Xiaomin is lazy and always sleeps.
And because of this, Xiao often worries about her, but does not know how to solve this problem. But sometimes, she gets tired of sleep and starts doing her own things.
According to the Longevity system, Xiaomin is a High-ranking mtsyr.
